description: No scene JSON or images were provided to analyze. Please attach the CoffeeMachine2 SCENE_JSON and optional VIEWS_MANIFEST_JSON and images so the scene can be analyzed.

diagnostics.message: SCENE_JSON not provided. I cannot extract object entries, roles, interactionParams, transforms, or bounding boxes without the scene JSON.
VIEWS_MANIFEST_JSON not provided. If you have a views manifest it can help confirm visual roles and states from images.
No images were provided. If you attach images they will be used only to confirm or refine roles and relationships, not measurements.

When you provide the CoffeeMachine2 SCENE_JSON, I will return a SceneUnderstanding JSON including ObjectEntry records (names, paths, transforms, materials, roles, interaction_params, confidence), Relations describing functional links, and Clusters grouping logical subassemblies.
